style_ref_note: ep04 plate (hands, bottle, desk lamp) used as the STYLE reference only
suffix: Draw it in exactly the same style as the reference image: black-and-white ink and charcoal illustration on warm cream paper, graphic-novel style, bold ink lines, dense cross-hatching, deep blacks, dramatic chiaroscuro. Do not copy the content of the reference. Vertical composition, the drawing fills the whole frame, no border. Greece, 1943-44. No text, no letters, no numbers, no signs, no signature, no watermark, no flags, no swastikas, no insignia.

shots.S03: The harbour of Zakynthos town in September 1943, seen from the end of the stone mole: Italian soldiers in grey-green wool uniforms with M33 helmets and side caps walk away in a line towards a small steamer, seen from behind as silhouettes, carrying kit bags. Low Venetian-style harbour buildings with arcades and a church bell tower behind. Overcast sky.
shots.S04: The same harbour: a small German military motor launch moored at the stone mole, a few German soldiers in field-grey uniforms and helmets stepping onto the quay, seen from far away and from behind, no faces. Fishing caiques, arcaded Venetian buildings, a Venetian castle on the hill above the town.
shots.S05: A narrow stone street of the old Jewish quarter of Zakynthos town before the 1953 earthquake: two-storey Venetian-style houses with wooden shutters and arched doorways, a modest synagogue facade with tall arched windows, laundry lines, an elderly man and a child seen from behind in the distance. Late afternoon light, long shadows.
shots.S06: Thessaloniki railway station in 1943: an empty platform beside a long line of closed wooden freight wagons, abandoned suitcases and bundles on the platform, steam in the air, no people. Bleak, silent, high viewpoint.
shots.S07: Zakynthos town hall at night in 1943: a Venetian-style public building with arcades on a dark square, a single lit window on the upper floor, the silhouette of a German sentry at the corner, wet paving stones.
shots.S08: Interior of a requisitioned office at night. In the foreground, the back and shoulders of a German officer seated at a heavy desk, his peaked cap on the desk, a gloved hand resting on papers. Across the desk a Greek civilian in a dark 1940s suit and overcoat stands as a silhouette against the light of the doorway, face in deep shadow. Desk lamp, tall shuttered window.
shots.S10: Close-up of the sliding door of a wooden freight wagon being closed, a sliver of darkness inside, a gloved hand on the iron handle, heavy shadows.
shots.S12: Close-up of a man's hands holding several handwritten sheets of paper with columns of illegible lines under a desk lamp at night, a fountain pen and an ink pot on the desk, a wedding ring, the sleeve of a 1940s suit.
shots.S13: At night, a man in a dark overcoat and hat seen from behind walks through an arcaded street towards an Orthodox church with a tall Venetian bell tower, a lantern glowing at the church door, empty street, wet stones.
shots.S14: Close-up of the hands of an elderly Greek Orthodox metropolitan resting on a wooden desk: black cassock sleeves, an ornate engolpion medallion on a chain on his chest, a prayer rope; a lit oil vigil lamp and a small icon in the background. His face is out of frame.
shots.S16: A Greek Orthodox metropolitan in a long black outer robe and a black kalimavkion hat with a black veil, seen from behind, walks calmly between two German sentries with rifles at the entrance of a requisitioned building. Daylight, long shadows.
shots.S17: Inside the German commander's office: in the foreground, seen over his shoulder from behind, the black robe and black veil of a Greek Orthodox metropolitan; across the desk the German officer in shadow, seen from the side, his face hidden by the peaked cap's shadow; a stack of papers between them. Tall window light.
shots.S20: Two men seen from behind standing side by side in front of a German officer's desk: on the left a Greek Orthodox metropolitan in a long black robe and black kalimavkion with black veil, on the right a younger man in a dark 1940s suit. Strong backlight from a tall window turns them into silhouettes; the officer is a dark shape behind the desk. Solemn, symmetrical composition.
shots.S21: A German officer seen from behind stands at a tall window looking out over a town at dusk, hands behind his back. On the desk behind him a single sheet of paper lies alone in a pool of lamplight.
shots.S22: At night, a line of families with bundles and small children walks up a rocky mountain path among olive trees, seen from far away as small silhouettes; a village with a few lit windows above; moonlight.
shots.S23: Inside the loft of a Greek village house: an oil lamp, a small Orthodox icon corner with a vigil light, wooden beams, straw; a family huddled in deep shadow at the far end, faces not visible; a village woman on the ladder bringing bread.
shots.S24: Greek resistance fighters on a mountain ridge at dawn, with rifles, bandoliers, caps and beards, seen as silhouettes from a distance; one young man runs down the slope towards a village below.
shots.S25: A narrow village lane: a German patrol of three soldiers in helmets walks away down the lane, seen from behind. In the foreground an old village woman in a black headscarf, seen from behind, closes a wooden shutter. Whitewashed stone houses, a vine.
shots.S27: Summer haze over the sea: three small German naval craft (motor launches and a small landing barge) approach the harbour of Zakynthos, seen from the hills above through olive trees, the town and the stone mole below.
shots.S28: The same small German naval craft leave the harbour, white wakes on the water, decks nearly empty, seen from far behind, the island receding; afternoon light.
shots.S30: The empty stone mole of Zakynthos harbour at dawn: a few moored fishing boats, coiled ropes, gulls, nobody waiting, a calm sea, first light behind the mountains.
shots.S33: A wide view of a village on a green hillside of Zakynthos at dawn: stone houses, olive groves, cypresses, many tiny figures of villagers at doorways and in the fields, smoke rising from chimneys, peaceful.
shots.S34: Close-up of a German officer's desk: a pile of unsigned typed orders, a fountain pen lying untouched beside them, a rubber stamp and an ink pad, an ashtray with a burned-out cigarette, the peaked cap at the edge of the frame; no person.
shots.S35: Aerial view of the island of Zakynthos at sunrise: the town on the bay with its harbour and stone mole, the Venetian castle on the hill above, olive groves and mountains, the sea; rays of light.
